//: Separate program for the OffscreenCanvas render worker.
projectm-render-worker.js runs in a Worker global scope, so it needs the
WebWorker lib (self.postMessage, importScripts, onmessage) instead of DOM.
The two libs declare conflicting globals and cannot share one program, so
the worker is checked here rather than in tsconfig.json. Both programs are
run by `npm run typecheck` (and therefore by scripts/check_html_types.sh).
